about: One entry per reference. verdict: pending | match | differences. After running compare.mjs, open the *-side-by-side*.png of each reference (Read tool / image viewer), list EVERY difference you see in `differences` ([{id, aspect, description, status}] with status open | fixed | accepted:<reason>), set `oursSha256` and `lookedAt` from out/compare-report.json, then verdict. `--check-review` prints REVIEW_OK only if every verdict is match, or differences with every item fixed/accepted:<reason>.

differences.description: Cogwheel shafts and rotation phase differ slightly from reference; base plate and checker match.
differences.status: accepted:cogwheel is a block-entity (BER) render owned by leaves B1-B5, not static B6

differences.description: Caption and button overlay placement differs in the diff heatmap.
differences.status: accepted:scene UI overlay, not renderer output

ref1.notes: Static base plate, casings, funnel and depot structure match in layout; remaining differences are block-entity parts, overlay and camera.

differences.description: Chain links between conveyors are missing in our render.
differences.status: accepted:chain conveyor links are drawn by its block-entity renderer (B-group owner, not B6)

differences.description: Reference shows a green wireframe highlight; ours shows a filled translucent green box.
differences.status: accepted:highlight style is scene overlay, not static model output

ref2.notes: Static base plate, casings, funnel and depot structure match in layout; remaining differences are block-entity parts, overlay and camera.

differences.description: Long mechanical belt on the left is missing in our render.
differences.status: accepted:belts are block-entity rendered (other leaf), not static

differences.description: Reference funnel and depot show item stacks; ours are empty.
Reference has an orange-topped block at the press output that has no clear static counterpart in ours; not confirmed as a static-model difference.
differences.status: accepted:unconfirmed, needs source check of the depot/item-holder model (open for follow-up)

differences.description: Our camera orientation differs from the reference, so the base plate proportions differ.

ref3.notes: Static base plate, casings, funnel and depot structure match in layout; remaining differences are block-entity parts, overlay and camera.

differences.description: Belt and press arm position differ from reference.

ref4.notes: Static base plate, casings, funnel and depot structure match in layout; remaining differences are block-entity parts, overlay and camera.
